name: Analysis plan
description: From a dataset profile and a question, plan the stages this dataset's values support — a technique and a why per stage — the indices worth computing and the metric each stage must report.

human_review.notes: Owner review 2026-09-23 15:28 (TBD-722): APPROVED skl_eda_plan 1.1.1 — the plan follows the values: technique menu, `technique` + `why` per stage, ≤ 12 stages with insights and suggestions last, `why` / `computes` sizes stated.

profile.description: output of the ingest cell: metrics and the profile table

columns.description: the real schema from ingest: name · dtype · nulls per column

examples.title: observations with organisation, time, distance and score

examples.title: a narrow csv

input.question: which months are unusual?
input.objective: understand the dataset from its values: column roles · a grouping · insights · suggestions · charts · data quality

examples.expected_output: {"stages": [{"id": "roles", "name": "What each column is", "technique": "column_roles", "why": "6 columns: month parses as dates, region has 5 distinct values, units and revenue are measures", "computes": "the roles table", "criteria": ["understanding.completed"]}, {"id": "monthly", "name": "Monthly totals and unusual months", "technique": "time_patterns", "why": "the question asks about months and `month` parses as dates", "computes": "units and revenue per month with a z-score, the unusual months flagged, a line chart", "criteria": ["structure.found"]}, {"id": "by_region", "name": "Revenue by region", "technique": "segmentation", "why": "`region` has 5 distinct values over 900 rows", "computes": "sum and mean per region, a bar chart", "criteria": []}, {"id": "dq", "name": "Data quality", "technique": "data_quality", "why": "always", "computes": "empty and duplicated fields", "criteria": ["dq.assessed"]}, {"id": "insights", "name": "What stands out", "technique": "insights", "why": "always", "computes": "Insights table, ≥ 3 rows", "criteria": ["insights.count"]}, {"id": "suggestions", "name": "What to look at next", "technique": "suggestions", "why": "always", "computes": "Suggestions table, ≥ 3 rows", "criteria": ["suggestions.count"]}], "indices": [{"name": "revenue per unit per region", "formula": "sum(revenue) / sum(units) grouped by region", "why": "separates price from volume in the regional comparison"}], "notes": "only two measures — clustering would not add to the segmentation, not planned"}
